To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
suppliers benefits from SCMS use are mediated by the extent to which suppliers invest in relationship-specific intangible assets, which are created by the use patterns of suppliers.

the use of SCMS by suppliers creates two distinct contexts: one that encourages exploration of new business opportunities, the other that encourages exploitation of existing ones, and both lead to benefits.

(1) suppliers who use an SCMS to exploit their relationships with a network leader are more likely to make relationship-specific investments in their business processes and in domain knowledge, and that these investments in turn enable them to create value and to capture a share of the value created; and (2) suppliers who use a SCMS to explore relationships with a network are less likely to make these investments, and that these suppliers are less likely to create value and capture a portion of it. 2.

suppliers can benefit from using an SCMS in a supply chain, but that these benefits depend on how they use it.
